notes: Exact JBL Professional EON15 (non-G2) passive 15-inch two-way system. The fetched JBL-branded manufacturer specification sheet states a frequency response of 80 Hz–16 kHz (−3 dB), a separate frequency range of 60 Hz–18 kHz (−10 dB), 100 dB SPL sensitivity at 1 W/1 m, 8 Ω nominal impedance, and 250 W power handling; it identifies one 15-inch LF transducer and an HF driver/horn, and explicitly describes this EON 15 as passive. The PDF is hosted by Warehouse Sound, not on a JBL domain; its document content identifies JBL Professional and the exact EON15 model. The similarly named powered EON15 G2 is a distinct later model and is not the source for these values. Published response limits are not a measured response curve; no response points or directivity dataset are imported. Source: https://www.warehousesound.com/r/jblEon15.pdf.
